source: {0} changes a draft of the config before it is final. {1} is the config as the user wrote it, and {2} reads files. Presets set their defaults here. The config of the project is applied after every hook, so it wins.
text: {0} 在配置最终确定之前修改配置草稿。{1} 是用户编写的原始配置，{2} 用于读取文件。预设在这里设置默认值。项目自身的配置会在所有钩子之后应用，因此优先级最高。
